criteria: CA RMSD <2 Angstrom AND ESMFold2 pLDDT >=80/100; backbone passes if any of four sequences passes
limitations: No formal equivalence margin was pre-established; absence of a significant difference is not evidence of equivalence.
16 pairs from one generator seed and one unconditional length range; no functional or experimental validation.
Identical timing repeats were excluded, and four sequence replicates were grouped by backbone.
Bootstrap intervals can be degenerate when all observed outcomes agree; Wilson intervals show finite-sample uncertainty.
Existing ESMFold2 container uses fallback numerical operators; both variants use the same evaluator environment.

generation_speed.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
generation_speed.method: Same initialized engine and weights; replace sampler.sample, sampler.ExampleRandomness, denoiser.denoise, engine._model_forward_batch with 749d94d implementations for before; torch kernels before, current auto triton-transition after. Both modes warmed before measurement.
limitations: Controlled function substitution, not a pristine checkout or old-SIF versus fast-SIF benchmark.
Both variants use current pinned loader and topology preparation; before computes unused cached indices.
Warm batch includes structure writing; three later batches per variant in this exact pair.
Request time excludes engine construction/checkpoint loading and prewarming; includes worker startup and output writing.
Biological evaluation reused previously generated structures; today’s refold runtimes do not measure RFD3 acceleration.

protocol.scope: Pilot on 16 paired unconditional 150–200-residue backbones; timing duplicates excluded
protocol.generator: B=4, compiled, 50 schedule points, seed 42; before torch versus optimized auto triton-transition
protocol.sequence_design: ProteinMPNN, temperature 0.1, seed 42, four sequences per backbone; one sidechain pack each
protocol.refolding: ESMFold2, one diffusion sample per sequence, three trunk loops, 200 sampling steps, seed 42, no templates or MSA
protocol.primary_outcome: Fraction of backbones with at least one sequence having CA-aligned CA RMSD <2 Angstrom and mean refold pLDDT >=80 (0–100 scale)
secondary_outcomes: All per-sequence CA RMSDs and pLDDT
Paired geometry, clashes, chain breaks, secondary structure fractions
protocol.analysis: Paired bootstrap confidence intervals over the 16 backbone pairs; sequence replicates are not independent backbones
protocol.limitations: Computational pilot only, no pre-established equivalence margin, limited power, no binding/function/experimental validation or longer/conditional inputs
